Quotes / Arthur Schopenhauer / Q0399

English

What a person is stands far more in his power than what he has.
Thinker Arthur Schopenhauer
School Philosophy of Will
Source Parerga and Paralipomena, Aphorisms on the Wisdom of Life

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

This English passage is associated with Parerga and Paralipomena, Aphorisms on the Wisdom of Life, within the tradition of Philosophy of Will. The wording below is a verified rendering prepared for careful reading rather than a claim of unique translation authority.

A short reading

Read in the register of character, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Arthur Schopenhauer's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
